mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 5-year average indicates an easing monetary policy cycle, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year average, despite the easing cycle conditions being met.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%, despite the trigger occurring.
